facts.business: John Cockerill India Limited provides engineering, project execution, and manufacturing services for metals processing equipment, including roll coating services, Jet Vapor Deposition (JVD), electrical steel, and high-strength steel solutions, operating as part of the John Cockerill Group.
key_risks: Revenue recognition for long-term projects involves significant judgments and estimates including identification of contractual obligations, expected duration, estimate of future costs, right to receive payments, changes in scope or duration, and recognition of liability for lossmaking contracts
Decarbonisation and sustainability transition in steel sector
Dependence on Group integration and technology access
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions approved with John Cockerill North America Inc. (rendering of services INR 45 crore, sale of goods INR 45 crore) and John Cockerill Industry Technologies (Beijing) Company Limited (receiving services INR 45 crore, purchase of goods INR 45 crore). Previous FY transactions with JC IT: INR 17.80 crore. Current FY Q1 transactions: expenses reimbursement INR 1.91 lakhs, shared services income INR 40.77 lakhs, purchase of goods reversed INR 0.77 lakhs.
